description: Lint every edited file with oxlint (PostToolUse) and block edits that turn an oxlint rule off (PreToolUse). Both hooks run from TypeScript source under Deno: the linter is resolved only from the edited project's node_modules, never from PATH. Claude Code blocks a PreToolUse call on exit 2 alone, so the config guard maps every inability to reach a verdict onto 2.

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno 2.x (https://deno.com) so the lint guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --allow-read --allow-run --allow-env=PATH,HOME,TMPDIR,TEMP,TMP,USERPROFILE,HOMEDRIVE,HOMEPATH,SystemRoot,COMSPEC,PATHEXT,CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/lint-guard.ts"

command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno 2.x (https://deno.com); blocking this edit because the config guard cannot run' >&2; exit 2; }; deno run --allow-read "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/config-guard.ts"; c=$?; { [ "$c" = 0 ] || [ "$c" = 2 ]; } || { echo "oxlint-guard: the config guard could not run (exit $c); blocking this edit" >&2; exit 2; }; exit "$c"
